title: Graduate Civil Engineer / Concrete Field Technician
apply_instructions: SEEK advert 95181464 (no screening questions). The employer's own careers page says: 'Ready to become part of our dynamic family? Send in your resume to admin@kh-geotech.com.au.'
rationale: Entry-level graduate field technician role with full training and NATA competencies; asks for a civil engineering degree (Marc holds a BSCE) or materials testing experience.

Marc holds the two named tickets, a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and did site inspections, quality checks and daily site reports in the Philippines, matching the daily technical logs and quality control duties.
Advanced Diploma coursework covered AS 1289 and AS 1726 (soil testing and geotechnical site investigation standards), relevant to soil, aggregate and concrete testing.
caution: Sydney based tunnel work while Marc lives in Melton, so it needs relocation (facts allow only 'open to discussing relocation'). No hands-on laboratory or concrete testing experience. Pay not stated; mandatory pre-employment medical with drug and alcohol screening (Marc has said yes to pre-employment checks). Field technician start, not a design role.
gaps: No commercial materials testing or NATA laboratory experience
Based in Melbourne, role is in Sydney
employer_line: K&H Geotechnical Services has provided soil testing, geotechnical engineering and NATA laboratory and field testing since 1993, and this role offers training on Tier-1 major tunnel infrastructure in Sydney.
